title: Total product stable influence
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $f\colon\Omega^n\to\mathbb{R}$. For $0<\rho\leq1$, the total stable influence of $f$ is the sum, over all $n$ coordinates, of its stable influence at that coordinate.
